steps: Confirm Alpaca paper account is ACTIVE and connected.
Confirm market clock is open and time is before 15:00 ET.
Refresh positions and open orders. Expect zero unless a prior ticket filled.
Fetch a fresh SPY quote. Reject if the feed is stale.
Generate a new client order id. Do not reuse November 12 ids.
Size one share. Apply the risk engine. Show the exact ticket.
Wait for explicit operator approval of that id.
Submit to the paper host only after approval.
Reconcile acknowledgment, fill, cash, and position.
A close after 15:00 ET is allowed. A new entry is not.
